hypothesis: evaluator-preference collapse occurs in 7-8B local models and is stronger under cross-family evaluation (llama3.1:8b judging qwen2.5:7b) than self-evaluation

kill_switch.note: collapse replicates locally with cross excess >= 0.15: extend to more rounds/tasks/seeds
no excess on small models: phenomenon bounded by capability/scale

tension: The published collapse finding conditions entirely on frontier evaluators. If small local models show the same cross-family excess, the phenomenon is about protocol design and every small-model deployer must account for it. If not, collapse theory needs a capability boundary it does not currently have.
